snippet.title: Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection - Release Date Trailer | TGS 2025 Extended Cut
snippet.description:
Watch an extended version of the Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection Release Date Trailer, featuring a deeper look into the game's story, characters, and world! Plus, get a first look as an electrifying foe emerges from the Forbidden Ground.

Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection launches on Nintendo Switch 2, PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC/Steam on March 13, 2026!
